data.name: Basoomah
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'basama' which means 'to rest on, to lean upon, or to rest the head'. The name Basoomah signifies the comfort, nourishment, and protection that a mother's breast provides to her child. In Islamic tradition, Basoomah is also a symbol of Allah's love and mercy, as He is the source of all comfort and sustenance.
